notes.title: It’s a whole new game—Tower Defense arrives in League of Fiends!
notes.notes:
To everyone who’s still enjoying the game—thank you!  
This update brings a brand-new mode: [b]Tower Defense Journey[/b],
featuring 30+ unique stages and more content than you can shake a stick at.

We’ve also polished several other areas:

- Sharper font rendering  
- Performance tweaks for smoother gameplay  
- A fresh coat of paint on the UI  
- Re-balanced synergy numbers  
- Three new synergies: **Plague Alchemist**, **Tactician**, and **Money Manager**  
- Talents reworked to thrive in Tower Defense  
- General balance passes on hero skills and synergies so everything feels right at home in the new mode

notes.title: fix bug
notes.notes: Due to the incomplete test of the last update, all summons cannot fight normally and cannot disappear, and the issue has been urgently fixed

notes.title: Performance optimization, increase equipment for sale
notes.notes:
Wow, you actually clicked in, that's all there is to this update, nothing else.
It's all here, and there's nothing to prepare. Then I wish you a good time and chase the three stars out of the five!

notes.title: Bug fixed on April 26, 2024, adding some small functions.
notes.notes:
1. Fix the problem that the player's equipment disappears after reading the archive after saving.
2. Repairing some achievements cannot be completed normally.
3. Fix the problem of losing the attribute obtained by adventure when upgrading.
4. Increase the function of selling chess pieces quickly.
5. Add some novice tutorials

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
This update fixes a number of bugs:
1. When loading a save, the Pawn Bond after the class change will be invalidated
2. The little fire dragon will become infinitely bigger in the preparation seat
3. Random chess piece mode difficulty selection problem
There are also some minor bugs that I won't repeat
Added some hovering hints
